description: This file defines a FileHandler class for managing file operations such as opening folders, editing files, and copying paths to clipboard, with support for admin and root editing via pkexec, using GTK and Gio libraries.

classes.name: FileHandler
classes.description: A class providing methods to open folders, edit files, and manage clipboard operations, with support for admin and root editing via pkexec.

methods.name: open_folder
methods.description: Opens a folder or file path in the system file manager.

methods.name: open_editor
methods.description: Opens a file in a supported text editor, with fallback options for admin and root editing.

methods.name: copy_to_clipboard
methods.description: Copies the given path string to the system clipboard.

methods.name: _get_file
methods.description: Returns a Gio.File object for the given path or URI.

methods.name: _file_is_writable
methods.description: Checks if a Gio.File is writable.

methods.name: _get_preferred_admin_editor
methods.description: Returns an editor that supports admin protocol, if available.

methods.name: _get_editor
methods.description: Retrieves the default text editor application info.

methods.name: _get_editors
methods.description: Retrieves all available text editors supporting 'text/plain' MIME type.

methods.name: _editor_supports_admin_protocol
methods.description: Checks if an editor supports admin protocol based on its name.

methods.name: _get_keyfile
methods.description: Loads a keyfile for a given editor application ID from system or user data directories.

methods.name: _get_pkexec_editor
methods.description: Creates a desktop app info for an editor with pkexec, modifying its command line.

methods.name: _get_root_editor
methods.description: Attempts to find a root-capable editor using pkexec, considering display server and policies.

methods.name: _get_display_server
methods.description: Determines if the display server is Wayland or X11.

methods.name: _get_pkexecs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of pkexec actions available on the system.
